## @interlace/leaderboard

Installed to `components/ui/games/leaderboard.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/games/leaderboard';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/leaderboard
